# The Duke's Letter

*Source: Session 3, the toll road*

A sealed letter, broken open in the tavern at Greymoor. The Duke of
Reynard asks Ilia Vane to carry a sealed pouch to the garrison at
Blackmoor before the next toll is collected.

The wax seal is broken, but the letter carries a second, smaller mark: a
thistle pressed into the parchment. Ilia Vane does not recognise it.

> [!note] The GM's aside
> The thistle is the mark of the spymaster. The party does not know this yet.
